description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for configuring browser language negotiation mappings, allowing administrators to add, delete, and validate language code mappings for site localization.

classes.name: NegotiationBrowserForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing language negotiation mappings based on browser language codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the language manager and parent configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for managing language mappings, including existing mappings and a form to add new ones.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form input, ensuring language codes are unique and properly formatted.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Saves the language mappings configuration upon form submission.

methods.name: language_get_browser_drupal_langcode_mappings
methods.description: Retrieves current language code mappings from configuration.
